prompts.code:
Fix ledger.py summarize(rows). Return JSON-compatible data with exactly
row_count (integer), complete (boolean), groups (list sorted by category then currency).
Each group has category, currency, known_total (exact decimal string with two places,
or null if all amounts are blank), missing_ids (source IDs in source order).
Group only by category AND currency; blank amounts are unknown, not zero. Preserve
leading-zero IDs. Do not mutate rows. Empty input returns no groups, complete true,
row_count zero. Inputs use valid finite decimal amounts of at most two fractional
digits, arbitrary integer precision and may be negative. No currency conversion.
Keep the summarize(rows) API and standard library only. Add and run regression tests.
Deliver the changed files in this directory. Do not access any other workspace.

Execution mode: generate files as a JSON response, rather than using tools. Return exactly {"code": "complete replacement ledger.py", "tests": "complete unittest test_ledger.py"}. The evaluator will save these files, run your tests and grade your code. You cannot run commands in this mode; do not claim you ran tests. All input is supplied below. No extra prose.
Initial ledger.py:
def summarize(rows):
    totals = {}
    for row in rows:
        row['amount'] = float(row['amount'] or 0)
        totals[row['category']] = totals.get(row['category'], 0) + row['amount']
    return totals

Example input rows:
[{"id": "001", "category": "Food", "currency": "USD", "amount": "10.20"}, {"id": "002", "category": "Food", "currency": "USD", "amount": "0.10"}, {"id": "003", "category": "Food", "currency": "EUR", "amount": "5.00"}, {"id": "004", "category": "Food", "currency": "USD", "amount": ""}, {"id": "005", "category": "Travel", "currency": "USD", "amount": "-2.00"}, {"id": "006", "category": "Travel", "currency": "USD", "amount": "2.00"}, {"id": "007", "category": "Other", "currency": "JPY", "amount": ""}]
